name: Chanida
description: A Singer-in-training from Khrueang who possesses an undocumented tonal range allowing her to hear lattice frequencies others cannot. She is impatient with the Tonal Orders' secrecy and believes resonance knowledge should be shared freely.

name: Pichit
description: A former Listener monk from Phrao who left the monastery after a spiritual crisis. He carries a resonant staff that allows short-distance communication through the lattice. His measured, philosophical approach balances the party.

name: Malee
description: A scavenger from the lattice surface who grew up on mobile platforms. She has a prosthetic leg made from harvested crystal core and can repair any resonance engine with scavenged parts. She is pragmatic and suspicious of skycity people.

name: Arthit
description: A former resonance ship captain who lost his vessel and crew to a catastrophic lattice surge. He carries maps of forgotten routes tattooed on his skin in ancient tonal notation. He is haunted but determined.

name: Skycity Resident
description: An ordinary person living on a floating skycity - a farmer, craftsperson, or shopkeeper who knows little of the lattice beyond what the Tonal Orders tell them.

name: Sky Pirate
description: A bandit who operates a modified resonance ship, attacking trade vessels between skycities. They know secret frequencies that can destabilize another ship's safe channel.

name: Trade Negotiator
description: A merchant who brokers deals between isolated skycities, traveling with Singer escorts. They carry news, letters, and rare goods from city to city.

name: Listener Monk
description: A member of the religious order studying the lattice's natural sounds, seeking to decode what they believe is the lattice's attempt to communicate with humanity.

name: Surface Scavenger
description: A hardy individual living on a fortified mobile platform on the lattice surface, harvesting crystal fragments and searching for pre-Silencing artifacts.

name: The Chronicler
description: An unnamed observer who records the party's journey, providing context, exposition, and occasional commentary on the ethical implications of their choices.

name: Ratana
description: A blind archivist at the Tonal Archives who 'sees' through resonance echoes. She can read the emotional history of any object by touch and guards forbidden knowledge about the Silencing's true cause.

name: Kamon
description: A disgraced Tonal Order enforcer who now sells his combat skills to the highest bidder. His resonance-hardened armor can absorb lattice surges, but the voices of those he silenced haunt his dreams.

name: Bussaba
description: A lattice-florist from Mae Rim's Hanging Gardens who cultivates crystal-blooming plants that respond to specific tonal frequencies. Her gardens hold the key to healing resonance sickness.

name: Thanet
description: A child prodigy who can instinctively navigate the lattice without instruments, a gift that hasn't been seen since before the Silencing. The Tonal Orders want to study him; the pirates want to sell him.

name: Suda
description: The last survivor of a skycity that fell to the surface. She carries a fragment of her city's resonance core and speaks to it like an old friend. She knows the location of the lost city of Sri Thep.

name: Prayut
description: A former resonance ship engineer turned saboteur who builds devices that can disrupt a city's tether to the lattice. He claims the skycities are parasites draining the lattice's life force.

name: Duangjai
description: A Singer from a rival tradition that uses harmonic layering rather than the Tonal Orders' individual resonance approach. Her polyphonic singing can achieve effects impossible for single-channel Singers.

name: Somsak
description: A smuggler who trades in contraband resonance artifacts from the surface. He has a network of informants in every skycity and knows which officials can be bribed and which must be avoided.

name: Niran
description: A hermit who lives in the Silent Zone, the one place where lattice resonance cannot penetrate. He has achieved a state of perfect mental silence and can teach others to shield their minds from lattice influence.

name: Ampa
description: A young cartographer mapping the lattice's shifting geometry. Her maps are illegal because the Tonal Orders control all spatial knowledge. She believes the lattice is growing, not dying.

name: Kanya
description: An anchor keeper who tunes the great moorings beneath Khrueang. Kanya hears a failing tether as a change in the floor's pulse and quietly records which officials ignore the warning.

name: Wichai
description: A resonance diver who descends through temporary channels to recover crystal cores. He is cheerful in danger, but every dive has left him with a different memory of the lattice.

name: Maliwan
description: A surface medic who runs a moving clinic on a reinforced harvest platform. Maliwan treats resonance sickness with practical remedies and insists that skycity patients learn the warning signs themselves.

name: Jintana
description: A junior clerk in the Tonal Orders who copies route permits by day and leaks censored frequencies by night. Her precise memory makes her a dangerous witness when the Orders rewrite a record.

name: Sakchai
description: A pirate navigator who can read a storm's harmonics from the vibration of a ship's rails. Sakchai wants out of the raiding life, but a hidden debt keeps pulling him back to the sky lanes.

name: Pailin
description: A crystal artisan whose bowls preserve a spoken tone for several minutes. Pailin sells beautiful work to the Orders while hiding a workshop where Groundless families share forbidden tools.

name: Rung
description: A Groundless organizer who builds safe surface shelters from ship ribs and lattice glass. Rung is an eloquent advocate for permanent settlement, yet refuses to send volunteers where the numbers are uncertain.

name: Nop
description: An archive conservator who repairs damaged route tablets with patient, nearly silent taps. Nop remembers every missing page and suspects the oldest gaps describe a deliberate experiment.

name: Chaiyo
description: A storm cartographer who maps wind shear by singing into glass kites. Chaiyo trades accurate forecasts for access to unredacted charts and never leaves a route unmarked.

name: Lalida
description: A skybridge courier who carries letters between islands on a tuned cable cart. Lalida knows the private entrances of every terminal and uses ordinary deliveries to move people the Orders would detain.
